# Hosted FormKit v5 single-root guard regression study

This follow-up is a separate within-host comparison of packed V0 (660d5beb), V4 (exact initial-placement patch), and V5 (one added short-circuit before recursive traversal when there are fewer than two root specs). The three non-peer arms, pinned dependency lock, common fixtures, trusted browser interaction, timestamps and cleanup assertions match the preceding hosted study. The single-root nested list is the workload eligible to skip traversal but not to batch; flat and validated forms are retention controls. A shorter mount-time reading is not a claim that the branch modified render order or fixed past browser stalls.

Gate: exact source delta, package check for V5 with a small focused single/multiple root witness, 18 browser behavior cells across both shapes sizes and a nine-case 1500-input measurement-mark smoke. Timed 1500-input flat/validated/rows only. One excluded warmup per arm and workload; 6 measured blocks, covering all 6 permutations exactly once; fresh browser per attempt, one serial job, original clock definitions and no retries or measurement exclusions. Artifacts retain failures, raw metrics and package/lock/browser hashes. Compare V5 to V4 and V0 within these blocks only.
